phases.title: Complete surface and basic piano
phases.outcome: The complete Nord Stage 4 surface for the assigned variant, with a playable keybed and one dependable piano voice. Every visible control moves or presses accessibly but does nothing else: panel controls are honestly decorative in this phase.
included: The variant's full chassis, keybed, six sections, controls, labels, LEDs, drawbars, faders, wheels, and the two OLED locations.
Pointer, touch, computer-keyboard, and Web MIDI note input through one shared note lifecycle.
One basic piano voice with velocity, release, sustain, polyphony with voice stealing, cleanup, and honest loading/error state.
Accessible movement (pointer and keyboard) for every visible knob, encoder, fader, drawbar, wheel, and button, stored as presentation state only.
excluded: Any panel control changing audio or system state; only keybed notes and sustain input are functional.
Multiple piano models, piano detail controls, and audible effects.
Programs, splits, scenes, morphs, Organ audio, and Synth audio.
hardGates: The exact keybed count and range for the assigned variant are modeled and playable.
The complete visible control surface is present with the documented section geometry, and Program and Synth are the only primary OLED locations.
The piano voice supports pointer, touch, computer keyboard, MIDI, velocity, release, sustain, polyphony, and cleanup.
Every visible panel control moves or presses accessibly but truthfully does nothing else.
Canonical desktop and narrow captures are complete with a written visual audit.

phases.title: Piano library and working effects
phases.outcome: The Piano section and the Layer Effects section become fully functional per their specs: six selectable piano types (three of them recorded sample sets), two piano layers, the piano performance controls, and the complete effect chain. Master Volume and Panic-equivalent cleanup also become real. Organ, Synth, and Program controls stay decorative.
included: All required features of specs/nord-stage-4.piano.json: six types, recorded Grand/Upright/Electric sample sets, two layers, KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res, sustain, and a labeled fallback.

All required features of specs/nord-stage-4.effects.json for the Piano layers: Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb, Rotary via To Rotary, with focus, group, global, bypass, and the documented order.
One AudioContext with per-layer buses, master gain and limiter, and one destination.
excluded: Programs, Live Mode, splits, zones, scenes, and morphs.
Organ and Synth sound engines; their controls stay decorative.
Everything the piano and effects specs list under excluded.
hardGates: Grand, Upright, and Electric are bundled recorded sample sets that are audibly distinct, work offline, and have complete redistributable provenance.
Every functional piano and effect control measurably changes rendered audio and agrees with its panel feedback.
Each effect unit and type processes real audio with working bypass and dry/wet.
One AudioContext feeds layer buses, ordered effects, master gain/limiter, and one destination.
The Phase 1 surface, keybed, and input behavior remain regression-free.

phases.title: Complete Stage 4 system
phases.outcome: All remaining sections become functional per their specs: the Organ engine, the Synth engine, and the Program section with 32 program slots, 8 Live slots, splits, scenes, morphs, master clock, transpose, and Panic. The instrument behaves as one serializable system; the only remaining decorative controls are the ones the specs explicitly exclude.
included: All required features of specs/nord-stage-4.programs.json: 32 programs, Store/Store As, dirty state, Live Mode, splits and zones with crossfades, Layer Scenes, Wheel and Control Pedal morphs, Master Clock, Transpose, and Panic.
All required features of specs/nord-stage-4.organ.json: two layers, distinct B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe engines, drawbars, percussion, key click, vibrato/chorus, and rotary integration.
All required features of specs/nord-stage-4.synth.json: three layers, the required waveform list, filters, envelopes, LFO, voice modes, and the arpeggiator/gate.
Organ and Synth route through the inherited effect chains, buses, and single destination.
Every control that is not spec-excluded has a meaningful canonical binding; spec-excluded controls are listed as unsupported.
excluded: Everything the programs, organ, and synth specs list under excluded (preset library, Extern, Aux KB, menus, aftertouch morph, pattern editing, and the rest).
Undocumented hardware behavior not present in the manual or specs.
hardGates: Program save/load round-trips all supported state across the 32 slots and 8 Live slots.
Splits, crossfades, scenes, morphs, and layer routing are editable from the panel and observable in audio.
B3, Vox, Farf, and Pipe organ engines and the required Synth source categories are audibly distinct, not renamed copies of one oscillator.
Organ and Synth route through the Phase 2 graph with no separate AudioContext.
All inherited visual, piano, effects, and input behavior remains regression-free.
